description: ContentWorker.java is a Java class implementing the ContentWorkerInterface for OFBiz, providing methods to manage, render, and traverse content objects within the OFBiz content management framework.

classes.name: ContentWorker
classes.description: Java class implementing content management functions in OFBiz, including rendering, traversal, fetching, and permission checks.

methods.name: findContentForRendering
methods.description: Fetches content for rendering based on content ID and localization.

methods.name: renderContentAsText
methods.description: Renders content as text output using dispatcher, content object, and context.

methods.name: renderContentAsText
methods.description: Convenience method that returns rendered content as String.

methods.name: renderContentAsText
methods.description: Renders content identified by its ID to an Appendable, considering the context and locale.

methods.name: renderSubContentAsText
methods.description: Renders sub-content specified by mapKey within content to String.

methods.name: renderSubContentAsText
methods.description: Renders sub-content identified by mapKey within content to Appendable.

methods.name: findAlternateLocaleContents
methods.description: Finds alternate locale versions of a content view.

methods.name: findAlternateLocaleContent
methods.description: Finds a specific alternate locale version of a content view.

methods.name: findAlternateLocaleContent
methods.description: Finds an alternate locale content considering localization and cache usage.

methods.name: traverse
methods.description: Recursively traverses content relationships based on associations, date constraints, and conditions.

methods.name: traverseSubContent
methods.description: Traverses subcontent nodes to decide the next path in content graph.

methods.name: getPurposes
methods.description: Retrieves list of purposes associated with a content.

methods.name: getSections
methods.description: Retrieves sections associated with a content based on categorizes predicate.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Retrieves topics associated with a content.

methods.name: selectKids
methods.description: Selects child content nodes based on association conditions.

methods.name: checkWhen
methods.description: Evaluates conditional expressions within context to determine boolean condition.

methods.name: getAssociatedContent
methods.description: Fetches associated content based on link direction, types, and date constraints.

methods.name: getAssociatedContentView
methods.description: Fetches associated content view with display of association criteria.

methods.name: getAssociations
methods.description: Gets list of content associations given current content and filtering parameters.

methods.name: getContentAssocsWithId
methods.description: Fetches content associations with specified content ID and filters.

methods.name: getContentTypeAncestry
methods.description: Recursively gathers ancestor content types.

methods.name: getContentAncestry
methods.description: Builds ancestry list of content based on associations.

methods.name: getContentAncestryAll
methods.description: Recursively gets all content ancestors filtering by type.

methods.name: getContentAncestryNodeTrail
methods.description: Builds a node trail of content ancestry as list of maps.

methods.name: getContentAncestryNodeTrailCsv
methods.description: Generates CSV string of content ancestry node trail.

methods.name: getContentAncestryValues
methods.description: Returns list of content ancestors as value objects.

methods.name: pullEntityValues
methods.description: Creates entity value object from context map.

methods.name: callContentPermissionCheck
methods.description: Performs permission check for content access based on context.

methods.name: callContentPermissionCheckResult
methods.description: Runs the permission check service and returns detailed results.

methods.name: getSubContent
methods.description: Retrieves sub-content entity value, either via association or direct subContentId.

methods.name: getSubContentCache
methods.description: Retrieves sub-content from cache or directly by ID.

methods.name: getSubContentCache
methods.description: Fetches sub-content cache view, with filtering.

methods.name: getContentCache
methods.description: Fetches content cache view.

methods.name: getCurrentContent
methods.description: Gets current content based on trail and context, with support for subContent and associations.

methods.name: getContentFromView
methods.description: Converts a view entity into content entity.

methods.name: buildPickContext
methods.description: Builds context map for associating content based on type and direction.
